2124626577098932387.en_summary: Goldman Sachs warns that the stock market bottom remains uncertain despite extreme selloff: $QQQ down 19.8% from October peak, $SPY down 12%, $NVDA down 48% since October 6, $VIX near 36 a 19-month high. Systematic traders sold $57 billion in equities past month, net short $19 billion. Desk favors selling put options over outright dip-buying citing Fed rate hikes, AI uncertainty and fragile liquidity. Thin Thanksgiving-week trading could amplify volatility before potential rebound.
